statement: KMIP 2.0 tags 0x420149 through 0x420152 are assigned by the pinned KMIP 2.0 Tag Enumeration and MUST NOT be classified as introduced in KMIP 2.1. This includes the Ticket, Ticket Type, Ticket Value, Request Count, Rights, Objects, Operations, Right, Endpoint Role and Defaults Information tags used by Login, Logout and Delegated Login structures.

source_section: OASIS KMIP 2.1 §11.56 Tag Enumeration; KMIP 3.0 §11.58 Table 605
statement: The VersionGate MUST continue rejecting KMIP 2.1 Constraints and Rotate tags 0x420168 through 0x420172 under KMIP 2.0, accept them under KMIP 2.1, and preserve the existing KMIP 3.0-only tag spans.

Typed KMIP 2.0 Login, Logout and Delegated Login requests using the standard session fields MUST pass the client pre-send VersionGate and reach transport; their KMIP 2.0 responses containing Ticket fields MUST validate.
